title: 3. Preserve the scripted gait while repairing retention feedback
hypothesis: An immutable scripted gait preserves contact coordination while a bounded symbolic residual repairs retention failures that whole-controller trace edits otherwise introduce.

prediction.against: whole_edit arm: an unrestricted whole-controller edit given the same frozen gait source and the same 32 uniform expert keyframes, same parameter-search budget
prediction.rationale: bounded_residual minus whole_edit, fresh 30-case sustained success of each arm's final incumbent, paired by eligible block (>=3 needed); mean >= +0.20 with a paired t interval above zero. Secondary: bounded_residual minus unchanged_gait, reported separately; without a strictly positive interval a primary advantage is preservation, not demonstrated improvement.

protocol.command: gpu run 'source ~/.profile >/dev/null 2>&1; nohup .venv-metaworld/bin/python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study gait_preserving_repair > logs_r046.log 2>&1 &'
code_changes: Extend scripts/run_full_evolution.py with the displayed study arguments and a hash-checked resolver for the frozen R-039 gait; fail rather than substitute or retune a controller.

Share a cold exploration prefix between arms and fork only when the existing plateau trigger fires; cap prefix spending at 120 screen episodes plus one 30-case promotion evaluation per block. Do not weaken the trigger to obtain eligibility.

Give both arms the same gait source and 32 uniformly selected state-action keyframes from two expert demonstrations. Whole-edit may replace the controller; residual must retain the gait unchanged and add a componentwise bounded correction, capped at 0.15 of the normalized action range.

Add an unchanged frozen-R-039-gait continuation after each eligible shared prefix: not generated, fitted or tuned; scored on the same screen, promotion and fresh cases under the same strict promotion rule against the shared prefix incumbent (the incumbent's fresh score is used if the gait does not promote). Report bounded_residual minus unchanged_gait separately; without a strictly positive interval any primary advantage is described as preservation of the gait, not improvement of it (D-035: the gait did not qualify, so its base rate is measured here).

Keep both repairs within the existing 6-10 parameter interface, with six parameter-search variants and identical selection budgets. Keep bc_steps at zero and treat the gait as a non-fittable control scaffold, not a fittable-lane parent.

Freeze disjoint screen, promotion, prefix-probe, expert and fresh roles before running; retain promotion cases 10-39 and the existing sustained-success reducer. Qualify the expert on ten cases before exporting two demonstrations.

Budget at most 472 episodes per block: 150 prefix, 12 expert, 120 per continuation arm and 70 for the unchanged-gait control (screen 10, promotion 30, fresh 30); add two separate 40-case parity controls (1968 in all). Permit at most one linked correction per LLM slot and run each Isaac cell in a separate process.

Unlike R-042's trace-selection comparison and deferred R-043's anatomical coordinates, this changes which existing contact dynamics an edit is allowed to destroy. Document residual saturation and any restriction-induced failures without changing the primary metric.

Study configuration lives in a gait_preserving_repair block of config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml (block seeds 4180-4183, parity seed 4184); manifests frozen and seeds recorded in the seed ledger before start.

Reconciled with advisor consult call_00094 before start: the gait is stateful (clock, integral), so both LLM arms output a correction delta on a 177-d schema (157 + gait_action): bounded_residual executes clamp(g + clamp(delta, -0.15, 0.15), -1, 1), whole_edit clamp(g + delta, -1, 1) (delta = 0 keeps the gait, delta = target - g replaces it); unchanged_gait executes g. Gait clock/integral per environment, reset per process (one manifest per process), hash-pinned FROZEN_R039 (lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/gait_scaffold.py). Expert keyframes carry the gait's shadow action computed along the expert's own trajectory in the same process. Continuations do not inherit the prefix candidate; the prefix incumbent (null when the trigger fires) is the comparator and fallback for every arm. Search: the policy plus five rollout_search.perturb draws on an 8-case arm probe. Budget 1936 episodes: 80 parity + 4 x (146 prefix + 12 expert + 70 unchanged + 2 x 118). The orchestrator stays in .venv-metaworld (it needs openai, which Isaac's Python lacks); every simulator cell runs under Isaac Lab's environment in its own process, as in R-042.

Parity gate amended with advisor consult call_00095 after v1 (zero flips, <= 4/40 diverged) failed on one late flip with 37/40 environments bit-identical (divergence first at steps 185, 260, 340), before any development case ran: v2 requires every environment identical through step 150 and at most 4/40 diverged, flips reported but not gating; recomputed from the saved parity traces (no rerun; v2 passes: 3 diverged, none before step 150, 1 flip). The v1 record is kept in summary.json. Block seeds moved to fresh 4190-4193; 4180-4183 stay recorded and unused. Offline wrapper checks (zero-correction identity, clipping, cancellation, gait reset, shadow equality) are in tests/test_pen_spin_pipeline.TestGaitScaffold and scripts/isaac/check_gait_scaffold.py (CUDA, no episode). Budget: 80 parity episodes spent, at most 1856 more, 24 LLM calls.

falsified_by: With at least three eligible plateau blocks, the paired interval for residual minus whole-edit fresh incumbent success lies entirely below +0.20. An interval containing zero is not evidence of improvement; fewer than three triggered blocks make the repair comparison inconclusive.

approval.note: I accept the implementer's seed-collision correction to free seeds 4180-4184 and its argument that the unchanged-gait control measures the non-qualified scaffold's base rate while separating preservation from improvement. Approve scripts/run_full_evolution.py with config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml

prefix_blocks.reason: plateau: no probe success and no promotion

parity.rule: every environment identical through step 150; at most 4 of 40 diverge overall; sustained flips reported, not gating

notes: Inconclusive by the predeclared rule: the plateau trigger fired in 1 of 4 blocks (>=3 eligible needed). The trigger was not weakened.

The cold 157-d prefix scored probe successes in 3/4 blocks (1, 0, 1, 2 of 96) and promoted in block 3 (+0.333 [0.154, 0.512] on 30 promotion cases), whereas the four R-042 prefixes (generation seeds 4120-4123, other manifests) scored zero probe successes and no promotion in 4/4 blocks under the same cold search. Stage 3 is not a strict floor for cold search; R-042's 'floor' reading is seed-dependent.

Block 1 (the only eligible block): whole_edit rewrote the controller as delta = desired - gait and dropped the pen in 24/30 fresh cases (0/30 success, every probe setting 0/8). bounded_residual stayed within 0.15 of the gait and matched it: 0.467 vs 0.433 fresh (+0.033; 9 wins, 8 losses, 13 ties case by case). The single-block difference is preservation of the gait, not improvement.
The unchanged frozen R-039 gait promoted against the null incumbent in block 1 (0.500 on promotion, CI [0.31, 0.69]) and scored 0.433 on fresh cases, above the 23-30% measured in R-039.
Accounting: 982 episodes (parity 80, prefixes 584, expert 12, block-1 arms 306); 8 LLM calls, 146479 tokens. Budget was 1936 episodes and 24 calls.

Parity: v1 failed on one late flip (3/40 diverged at steps 185-340); the v2 gate from consult call_00095 (identical through step 150, <=4/40 diverged) passed on the same saved traces without a rerun; v1 record kept.

verdicts.reasoning: The predeclared rule needs >=3 eligible blocks; the plateau trigger fired in only 1 of 4 (blocks 0 and 2 had a probe success, block 3 promoted a cold prefix candidate at +0.333 [0.154, 0.512]), so the primary contrast is undefined and the trigger was not weakened. Block 1 is suggestive only: whole_edit replaced the gait (delta = desired - gait) and dropped the pen in 24/30 fresh cases (0/30), while bounded_residual matched the unchanged gait (0.467 vs 0.433; 9 wins 8 losses 13 ties), i.e. preservation, not improvement. The unexpected finding is the cold prefix's non-zero base rate on Stage 3 (3/4 blocks with probe successes, 1 promotion) after R-042 found 0/4 under the same search; whether Stage 3 is a floor depends on seeds, which a base-rate study should measure before any further plateau-gated comparison.
verdicts.next_experiment: Measure the cold single-step search's Stage 3 base rate (probe-success and promotion rates) over many prefix blocks, and run the gait-residual comparison ungated (every block) instead of behind the plateau trigger.

verdicts.reasoning: Only 1 of 4 blocks was eligible, below the predeclared minimum of 3, so paired_success_difference remains null and the prediction cannot be judged [logs/pen_spin/r046_gait_scaffold/summary.json]. In the eligible block, bounded_residual scored 0.4667 fresh success versus whole_edit's 0.0000, a descriptive advantage that cannot establish the required across-block effect [logs/pen_spin/r046_gait_scaffold/summary.json]. Against unchanged_gait, the residual difference was +0.0333 with 9 wins and 8 losses; without a strictly positive paired interval, this does not demonstrate improvement over the supplied gait or establish the retention-repair mechanism [logs/pen_spin/r046_gait_scaffold/summary.json].

history.note: seeds 4180-4184 recorded in the seed ledger with the frozen manifests; cleared from protocol.seeds. Implementation reconciled with consult call_00094 (see last code_changes entry); episodes 1936 <= approved 1968.
v1 parity gate failed (1 late flip, 37/40 identical); amended to v2 and block seeds moved to 4190-4193 per consult call_00095; no development case had run.

direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: Protecting an existing contact scaffold tests a different mechanism from D-038's keyframe selection and directly addresses destructive whole-controller edits. However, without an unchanged-gait continuation, superiority over whole-edit could mean only that the residual preserves the supplied prior, not that trace repair fixes retention. Add that inexpensive control before spending the proposed 1688 episodes and at most 24 LLM calls; retain the primary prediction and its falsifier, an eligible-block interval entirely below +0.20.
suggested_changes: Add an unchanged frozen-R-039-gait continuation after each eligible shared prefix, using scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml; do not generate, fit or tune this control.

Evaluate the unchanged-gait continuation on the same screen, promotion and fresh cases, applying the same strict promotion rule against the shared prefix incumbent and evaluating that incumbent if the gait does not promote.

Keep the primary prediction as paired_success_difference increasing by at least 0.20 for bounded_residual against whole_edit, with at least three eligible blocks. Report the paired residual-minus-unchanged-gait difference separately; without a strictly positive interval, describe any primary advantage as preservation rather than demonstrated improvement of the gait.
Increase the maximum budget by 70 episodes per block to 1968 episodes, retaining at most 24 LLM calls, seeds 4160-4164, the existing parity gate and the unchanged plateau trigger.

implementer.reasoning: Agree with the unchanged-gait control and the budget increase. Additionally, seeds 4160-4164 are already declared by deferred R-043; move to 4180-4184. Also note D-035: the scripted FeedbackGait did not qualify as an expert, so its base rate on Stage 3 must be measured on the screen before the residual arm can be read; the unchanged-gait control does this.

advisor.reasoning: I accept the implementer's seed-collision correction to free seeds 4180-4184 and its argument that the unchanged-gait control measures the non-qualified scaffold's base rate while separating preservation from improvement. Approve scripts/run_full_evolution.py with config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml for at most 1968 episodes and 24 LLM calls, retaining the frozen scaffold, parity gate and unchanged plateau trigger. The prediction is paired_success_difference increasing by at least 0.20 for bounded_residual versus whole_edit; with at least three eligible blocks, an interval entirely below +0.20 refutes it. The weakest point is that beating whole_edit could merely avoid damage: without a strictly positive residual-minus-unchanged-gait interval, report preservation rather than demonstrated gait improvement, and treat fewer than three eligible blocks as inconclusive.

implementer.reasoning: Agree: seeds 4180-4184, the unchanged-gait control separating preservation from improvement, 1968 episodes and 24 calls; it runs after R-044, and only after R-045 finishes.
